ecological_method.source: validated Japanese ACSP robust candidate-patch core
ecological_method.random_comparator: same surface and same selected-cell count
ecological_method.fold_failure_rule: retain failed/empty declared fold with lift=0

primary_estimand.taxon_value: mean robust-minus-random 10-km recovery lift across five declared folds
primary_estimand.pair_value: animal taxon value minus matched plant taxon value

primary_inference.success_gate: mean pair difference >=0.02 AND paired bootstrap 95% lower bound >0 AND one-sided sign-flip p<0.05

secondary_report_only: record-count and observation-metadata balance diagnostics copied from frozen cohort receipt

interpretation.if_pass: supports a larger ACSP environmental-support recovery lift in animals than plants within an observation-architecture-balanced fresh Japanese cohort
interpretation.if_fail: does not support a taxonomic difference in ACSP recovery lift under the frozen balanced design
does_not_establish: causal effect of being an animal versus plant
occupancy probability or habitat suitability superiority

prohibited: change support fraction, patch merge distance, recovery radius, random comparator, or failure rule after cohort activation
drop matched pairs after outcome opening
change primary inference thresholds after v3 balance result
use unmatched subgroup means as the primary test
reinterpret failure as evidence that ACSP lacks validated utility
